title: DINNER LADY 50ml Sweet Shortfill E-Liquid – Apple Sours
description:
Dinner Lady’s Apple Sour is excellent all day vape e-liquid while being satisfying sweet but not overpowering. The crisp apple taste is present throughout each vape with its tangy sourness coming through on every exhale.
Flavour:
Apple
Sherbet
VG/PG:
70% VG, 30% PG
Bottle size:
60ml filled with 50ml for your nicotine shot.
Nicotine Levels:
Zero – 0mg/ml
